The 100% row is retained as historical strategy context and its August 20 composition date is unchanged. Publication remains blocked on a same-block sUSD/hUSDC liability-to-asset reconciliation and verification of the BSC USDC held claim and bridge escrow. Next evidence: read the immutable underlying/strategy/vault asset contracts, vUSDC balances and exchange rate, idle balances, debt and circulating liabilities at one BSC block; annotate a verified bridge representation before admitting any issuer look-through edge.
